headline: 技能包长出工具链
summary: 本周近四成上榜项目围着 agent skill 转：写技能包的、做注册表与跨工具同步的都有，NVIDIA 还出了 SkillEvaluator 做评估。技能正从随手提示词变成可管、可评的工程资产。

newEntries.name: caveman
newEntries.description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.
newEntries.comment: 让 agent 学原始人说话省 token 的 skill，少说少读代码不动；十二万星，本周涨两千多。

newEntries.name: ha-mcp
newEntries.description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
newEntries.comment: 用 MCP 让 Claude 等 AI 助手管理 Home Assistant，86 个工具；本周涨两千多星。

newEntries.name: instagram-agent-skill
newEntries.description: Thirteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 scored hook formulas, a viral research skill, a caption linter, and a humanizer. Free, MIT.
newEntries.comment: 十三个 Claude skill 运营 Instagram：钩子公式、爆款研究、去 AI 味，本周涨一千多星。

newEntries.name: CLIProxyAPI
newEntries.description: Wrap Antigravity, ChatGPT Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, Muse Code, Devin as an OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini Series, GPT Series, Grok Series, Claude model through API
newEntries.comment: 把 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 包成 OpenAI 兼容 API，本周涨七百多星。

newEntries.name: claude-code-templates
newEntries.description: Open-source registry and CLI for Claude Code components: agents, commands, skills, hooks, MCPs, settings and mods
newEntries.comment: Claude Code 组件注册表，一条命令装 skills、agents、hooks，本周涨六百多星。

newEntries.name: a2ui
newEntries.description: Open-source generative UI framework: agents stream layout data, and apps render it with native components in React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.
newEntries.comment: 生成式 UI 换了做法：agent 只流式输出数据，React、Flutter、SwiftUI 原生渲染。

newEntries.name: skillshare
newEntries.description: 📚 Sync skills, agents, MCP, plugins to all AI CLI tools with one command and simplify team sharing.
newEntries.comment: 换 AI 工具不重配：一条命令把 skills、MCP、hooks 同步到各家 CLI，Git 版本化共享。

newEntries.name: security-audit-skill
newEntries.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
newEntries.comment: Cloudflare 漏洞挖掘系统的起点：让编码 agent 跑六阶段安全审计，发现经独立验证。

newEntries.name: ollama
newEntries.description: Get up and running with Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
newEntries.comment: 十八万星的本地模型运行时，一条命令拉起 Claude Code、Codex 等编码 agent。

newEntries.name: SkillEvaluator
newEntries.description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills and plugins with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.
newEntries.comment: NVIDIA 出的 skill 评估框架：质量门禁、重叠检测，实测装 skill 前后 agent 表现差异。

newEntries.name: LoopForge
newEntries.description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
newEntries.comment: 腾讯出的编码 agent 交付平台：沙箱编排 Codex、Claude Code，人工审批后才出 PR。

newEntries.name: gods-eye-view
newEntries.description: God's Eye View: a spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe. Official site: godseyeview.ai
newEntries.comment: 浏览器里的间谍卫星模拟器，数据是真的：航班、船舶、卫星实时标上 3D 地球，六万五千星。

newEntries.name: paper-orchestra
newEntries.description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
newEntries.comment: Google 出的多 agent 论文写作框架，把想法与实验日志变成可投稿 LaTeX，自动文献综述和配图。

newEntries.name: MatrixMedia
newEntries.description: 视频矩阵工具 vue electorn puppeteer 批量发布 视频到各个视频平台 自媒体 矩阵 抖音 小红书 头条 视频号 快手等 ai 自动化 cli
newEntries.comment: 把视频批量分发到抖音、B 站等八个平台，CLI 和 HTTP API 可供 agent 调用。

newEntries.name: claude-second-brain
newEntries.description: Fastest way to scaffold your LLM powered personal knowledge base - Obsidian, Claude Code, qmd, Github
newEntries.comment: npx 一键搭 Claude Code 知识库：资料喂进去长成互链 wiki，qmd 本地搜索。
